paragraphs.text:
Your  threat  impressed  Charlie.  Rather  than  end  up  with 
nothing for her efforts, she sneaks off that night during her 
watch, taking the canoe and a share of the supplies as payment. 
Norman and Sylvia cannot meet your eyes for a few hours.

To  start  back  upriver  with  your  students,  go  to  600. To  take  a 
circuitous route back toward the fort, keeping an eye out for new 
discoveries, go to 324. To head directly to the fort, go to 593.
